pages.text: The $(item)Analytic Continuator$() is a console now, and built from early parts (Rational Fields, glass, clocks, iron and redstone).

It carries a function from where it is known to where it is wanted, a disc at a time. Set the disc radius ρ and the terms N: each disc leaves about (ρ/R)^(N+1) of error, L/ρ discs cover the distance, and the total must be under the recipe's tolerance. Bigger discs need fewer steps but more terms; past the radius of convergence the series diverges. Harder recipes carry it further and finer. Its calibration: match a waveform.
